class.name: SteamServerBrowser
class.brief_description: Steam dedicated server discovery for one exact signed-in client scope.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Return whether the owning Steam client start supports the server browser.

method.name: query
method.description: Return detached options for Steam Internet or LAN discovery. Omit the namespace to use the owning game's namespace or [code]crimson[/code] on a standalone client. A Game scope cannot override its namespace.

method.name: inspect
method.description: Refresh one selected server using its native Steam query port. The response must match the selected AppID, namespace, server identity and address. Timeout accepts 100 to 15000 milliseconds.
